description: This file defines the SuiteEditorConnector class which manages different HTML editors for user preferences in SuiteCRM, including methods for obtaining configuration settings and rendering editor HTML based on user preferences.

classes.name: SuiteEditorConnector
classes.description: A connector class for managing different HTML editors based on user preferences, providing configuration settings and rendering HTML.

methods.name: getSuiteSettings
methods.description: Returns configuration settings for the TinyMCE editor, including dynamic setup scripts based on the context.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Renders the HTML for the selected editor type based on user preferences.
